requirements.Title: NGB Keyed Ink Bottles with High Page Yield
requirements.Description: Develop new NGB keyed ink bottles supporting 6K Black and 6K CMY page yields, with CMY bottle size supporting >8K pages.
requirements.Rationale: To increase ink capacity and reduce frequency of cartridge changes, supporting high-volume printing and customer convenience.
requirements.Dependencies: Requires bottle design, compatibility with NOA-F and Magi/Nessie inks, and integration with IDS.
requirements.Acceptance Criteria: NGB keyed bottles are available in 6K Black and 6K CMY variants, CMY bottle size supports >8K pages, and bottles are compatible with the printer and ink system.

requirements.Title: Spill-Free Ink Bottle Reliability
requirements.Description: Ensure new ink bottles are designed to be spill-free during installation and replacement.
requirements.Rationale: To improve user experience and reduce mess or damage during ink replacement.
requirements.Dependencies: Depends on bottle design and integration with NOA-F system.
requirements.Acceptance Criteria: Ink bottles can be installed and removed without any ink spillage under standard use conditions.

requirements.Title: NOA-F with Metal Foiled Labyrinth and Lid Label
requirements.Description: Integrate a NOA-F (Next-Gen Output Assembly - Filter) featuring a metal foiled labyrinth and a lid label, with no change to click-on push-push and TDF mechanisms.
requirements.Rationale: To enhance reliability and ensure compatibility with existing mechanisms while improving filtration and identification.
requirements.Dependencies: Requires design updates to NOA-F and coordination with bottle and tank design.
requirements.Acceptance Criteria: NOA-F includes metal foiled labyrinth and lid label, and is compatible with push-push and TDF mechanisms.

requirements.Title: Reuse SuperAmp Si PHA and Magi/Nessie Ink
requirements.Description: Reuse existing SuperAmp Si PHA and Magi/Nessie ink formulations without reformulation.
requirements.Rationale: To leverage proven technology, reduce development time, and ensure ink reliability.
requirements.Dependencies: Compatibility with new bottle and NOA-F design.
requirements.Acceptance Criteria: SuperAmp Si PHA and Magi/Nessie ink are used without any reformulation in the new product.

requirements.Title: Reliability and Characterization Modelling
requirements.Description: Conduct reliability, WVTR (Water Vapor Transmission Rate), air gain, flow rate, and IDS (Ink Delivery System) characterization and modelling, including startup and NOA-F end-of-life.
requirements.Rationale: To ensure robust performance, predict failure modes, and optimize ink delivery.
requirements.Dependencies: Requires finalized hardware and ink system design.
requirements.Acceptance Criteria: Comprehensive models and test results for reliability, WVTR, air gain, flow rate, and IDS are documented and meet product targets.

requirements.Title: Ink Stability Modelling in Tank
requirements.Description: Model ink stability in the tank and its impact on print quality (PQ).
requirements.Rationale: To ensure ink remains stable over time, maintaining high print quality throughout tank life.
requirements.Dependencies: Requires tank design and ink formulation data.
requirements.Acceptance Criteria: Ink stability modelling is completed with documented impact on print quality, and mitigation measures (if required) are implemented.

requirements.Title: Support for Services and Contractual Requirements
requirements.Description: Enable printer and supplies to support service/contractual requirements, including NOA-F as service parts in warranty support.
requirements.Rationale: To fulfill warranty and service obligations and streamline service operations.
requirements.Dependencies: Requires service documentation and spare part logistics.
requirements.Acceptance Criteria: NOA-F and other service parts are available and documented for warranty support.

requirements.Title: Acumen 6 on Lid for Authentication
requirements.Description: Integrate Acumen 6 technology on the lid for authentication and security.
requirements.Rationale: To prevent counterfeiting and ensure only genuine supplies are used.
requirements.Dependencies: Requires integration with lid design and authentication systems.
requirements.Acceptance Criteria: Acumen 6 is present on the lid and functions as intended for authentication.

requirements.Title: Factory Line Modifications for NOA-F
requirements.Description: Modify existing SA 14 production line to support NOA-F manufacturing.
requirements.Rationale: To enable efficient production of new NOA-F components.
requirements.Dependencies: Depends on finalized NOA-F design.
requirements.Acceptance Criteria: SA 14 line is updated and validated for NOA-F production.

requirements.Title: Integration of Magi Ink Cartridge and Labelling Tool in Orcus 5
requirements.Description: Add Magi ink cartridge and labelling tool to the Orcus 5 production line.
requirements.Rationale: To support assembly and labeling of new ink cartridges.
requirements.Dependencies: Requires finalized cartridge and label design.
requirements.Acceptance Criteria: Orcus 5 line is equipped with Magi ink cartridge and labelling tool, validated for production.

requirements.Title: Assembly of PHA + Dry FI + USG + Push-Push in Printer Factory
requirements.Description: Assemble PHA, Dry FI, USG, and push-push mechanisms in the printer factory.
requirements.Rationale: To centralize assembly and improve quality control.
requirements.Dependencies: Requires supply chain coordination and assembly process design.
requirements.Acceptance Criteria: Printer factory assembles all specified components, validated by QA.

requirements.Title: ISDO Capex for Production Upgrades
requirements.Description: Allocate capital expenditure for SA14 line upgrades, Magi and Nessie ink cart and labelling tool in Orcus 5, and molds for 1 to 4 new keyed caps.
requirements.Rationale: To ensure production readiness for new product features.
requirements.Dependencies: Approval of capex budget and project management.
requirements.Acceptance Criteria: Capex is allocated and upgrades are implemented as planned.

requirements.Title: Leverage Watt LE / Marconi Hi Mech + CISS
requirements.Description: Utilize Watt LE and Marconi Hi mechanical platforms with integrated CISS (Continuous Ink Supply System).
requirements.Rationale: To accelerate time to market and reduce investment by leveraging existing platforms.
requirements.Dependencies: Requires compatibility validation with new features.
requirements.Acceptance Criteria: Product is based on Watt LE / Marconi Hi platform with integrated CISS.

requirements.Title: Print Speed Requirement (25/20 ppm, PDL: 25/19 ppm)
requirements.Description: Printer must support print speeds of 25 ppm (pages per minute) for standard and 20 ppm for color, with PDL support at 25/19 ppm.
requirements.Rationale: To meet market expectations for productivity and throughput.
requirements.Dependencies: Depends on print engine and IDS performance.
requirements.Acceptance Criteria: Printer achieves 25/20 ppm (standard/color) and 25/19 ppm (PDL) in testing.

requirements.Title: Customer Replaceable PHA and NOA-F
requirements.Description: Design PHA (Print Head Assembly) and NOA-F to be customer-replaceable.
requirements.Rationale: To improve user experience and reduce downtime/costs for maintenance.
requirements.Dependencies: Requires design for tool-less or simple replacement.
requirements.Acceptance Criteria: End users can replace PHA and NOA-F without special tools or service calls.

requirements.Title: New Warranty Page Life Goal of 80K Pages
requirements.Description: Support a new warranty page life goal of 80,000 printed pages per device.
requirements.Rationale: To provide competitive warranty terms and demonstrate product reliability.
requirements.Dependencies: Depends on component durability and reliability.
requirements.Acceptance Criteria: Device is warrantied for 80K pages, validated through reliability testing.

requirements.Title: SKU 2 (Hi + Hi PDL) PaaS Offering
requirements.Description: Offer a second SKU supporting both high capacity and PDL (Page Description Language) features as a Platform-as-a-Service (PaaS).
requirements.Rationale: To address diverse market segments and provide flexible business models.
requirements.Dependencies: Requires product configuration and service integration.
requirements.Acceptance Criteria: SKU 2 is available for order with PaaS support and validated features.

requirements.Title: Reddington ID with Increased Tank Size
requirements.Description: Increase tank size for the product using Reddington ID, with no change to Marconi-HI ADF.
requirements.Rationale: To support higher ink capacity and page yield.
requirements.Dependencies: Tank and chassis design changes.
requirements.Acceptance Criteria: Tank size is increased and validated, ADF remains unchanged.

requirements.Title: EPS Foam Packaging
requirements.Description: Use EPS foam packaging for product protection during shipping.
requirements.Rationale: To ensure product safety and reduce shipping damage.
requirements.Dependencies: Requires packaging design and sourcing.
requirements.Acceptance Criteria: EPS foam packaging is used and passes drop/impact tests.

requirements.Title: EPEAT3 and LOT4 Environmental Compliance, Blue Angel for PDL SKU
requirements.Description: Ensure compliance with EPEAT3 and LOT4 environmental standards, and Blue Angel certification for PDL SKU.
requirements.Rationale: To meet regulatory requirements and enhance environmental credentials.
requirements.Dependencies: Requires certification processes and design compliance.
requirements.Acceptance Criteria: Product is certified for EPEAT3, LOT4, and Blue Angel (PDL SKU).

requirements.Title: Input and Output Tray Changes for Tank Protrusion
requirements.Description: Modify input and output trays to align with tank protrusion and optimize size.
requirements.Rationale: To ensure mechanical compatibility and minimize product footprint.
requirements.Dependencies: Tank and chassis design changes.
requirements.Acceptance Criteria: Trays are modified and validated for tank protrusion and size optimization.

requirements.Title: 4.3” CGD Display
requirements.Description: Integrate a 4.3” CGD (Color Graphic Display) for user interface.
requirements.Rationale: To provide a modern, user-friendly interface for device operation and status.
requirements.Dependencies: Requires hardware and firmware integration.
requirements.Acceptance Criteria: Device includes a 4.3” CGD display, fully functional for all UI operations.

requirements.Title: Platform with 4 Sayan Sibstar Tubes and New Tube Routing
requirements.Description: Leverage Sayan Sibstar tubes (4) with new tube routing and integration.
requirements.Rationale: To improve ink delivery efficiency and support new tank layout.
requirements.Dependencies: Tank and IDS design changes.
requirements.Acceptance Criteria: Platform uses 4 Sayan Sibstar tubes with validated routing and integration.

requirements.Title: Service Station Aerosol Management with Spit Platform Changes
requirements.Description: Update service station for improved aerosol management due to new tank design and spit platform changes.
requirements.Rationale: To maintain reliability and cleanliness with increased ink capacity.
requirements.Dependencies: Tank and service station design changes.
requirements.Acceptance Criteria: Service station effectively manages aerosol, validated in testing.

requirements.Title: Carriage Dynamic and Force Model with Tube and New Weights
requirements.Description: Model carriage dynamics and forces considering new tube routing and increased component weights.
requirements.Rationale: To ensure print quality and mechanical reliability with updated design.
requirements.Dependencies: Tube, tank, and carriage design changes.
requirements.Acceptance Criteria: Carriage model is updated and validated for new weights and routing.

requirements.Title: Paper Path to Support Increased Page Life
requirements.Description: Update paper path design to support increased page life of 80K pages.
requirements.Rationale: To ensure durability and reliability throughout the product warranty period.
requirements.Dependencies: Depends on overall mechanical and component reliability.
requirements.Acceptance Criteria: Paper path components are validated for 80K page life in testing.

requirements.Title: Ink Maintenance as a Serviceable Part Post 80K Life
requirements.Description: Design ink maintenance as a serviceable part that can be replaced at service centers after 80K page life.
requirements.Rationale: To extend product usability and reduce total cost of ownership.
requirements.Dependencies: Requires service documentation and part supply.
requirements.Acceptance Criteria: Ink maintenance part is serviceable post 80K pages, with service center procedures documented.

requirements.Title: SuperAmp PHA, NOA-F, Keyed Bottles, Magi and Nessie Pigment Inks, 140ml K Bottles, XX ml CMY Bottles
requirements.Description: Support for SuperAmp PHA, NOA-F, keyed bottles, Magi and Nessie pigment inks, 140ml Black bottles (new), and XX ml CMY bottles.
requirements.Rationale: To meet expanded ink and supply requirements for new product.
requirements.Dependencies: Requires supply chain coordination and compatibility testing.
requirements.Acceptance Criteria: All listed supplies are available, compatible, and validated for use.

requirements.Title: New Make-Break and FI Connection for IDS
requirements.Description: Implement new make-break and FI (Fluidic Interconnect) connection for the Ink Delivery System (IDS).
requirements.Rationale: To improve reliability, serviceability, and ink flow.
requirements.Dependencies: Requires IDS and hardware design updates.
requirements.Acceptance Criteria: New make-break and FI connections are functional and validated in IDS.

requirements.Title: Leverage LEBI Ink-Tank with Increased Size, Keying, and LOI One SHAID
requirements.Description: Use LEBI ink-tank system with increased size, keying, and single SHAID (Security Hardware Authentication ID).
requirements.Rationale: To support higher ink volumes and improve security/authentication.
requirements.Dependencies: Tank and IDS design changes, SHAID integration.
requirements.Acceptance Criteria: LEBI ink-tank is used with increased size, keying, and one SHAID, validated for security and compatibility.

requirements.Title: New IDS Startup Algorithm and Air Management
requirements.Description: Develop new startup algorithm and air management process for IDS.
requirements.Rationale: To ensure reliable ink delivery and minimize startup issues.
requirements.Dependencies: IDS hardware and firmware updates.
requirements.Acceptance Criteria: New startup algorithm and air management are implemented and validated in IDS.

requirements.Title: Reuse Marconi Hi PDL for Web Services
requirements.Description: Leverage Marconi Hi PDL for web services integration.
requirements.Rationale: To accelerate development and maintain compatibility with existing solutions.
requirements.Dependencies: Web service integration and PDL compatibility.
requirements.Acceptance Criteria: Marconi Hi PDL is used for web services, validated in solution testing.

requirements.Title: New Servicing and Startup Algorithm
requirements.Description: Develop new servicing and startup algorithms to support new ink system and page yield definition.
requirements.Rationale: To optimize product reliability and performance.
requirements.Dependencies: Requires IDS and firmware updates.
requirements.Acceptance Criteria: Algorithms are implemented and validated in servicing and startup scenarios.

requirements.Title: New Print Quality (PQ) Goals and Depletion to Meet Page Yield Definition
requirements.Description: Establish new print quality (PQ) goals and depletion rates to align with updated page yield definitions.
requirements.Rationale: To ensure customer expectations for print quality and yield are met.
requirements.Dependencies: Depends on ink, IDS, and print engine design.
requirements.Acceptance Criteria: PQ goals and depletion rates are defined, implemented, and validated against page yield targets.

requirements.Title: Reuse Marconi Tux dASIC, Hannibal aASIC, Raccoon PSU
requirements.Description: Reuse existing Marconi Tux dASIC, Hannibal aASIC, and Raccoon PSU for electronics.
requirements.Rationale: To leverage proven components and reduce development costs.
requirements.Dependencies: Compatibility with new platform and features.
requirements.Acceptance Criteria: All listed electronics are reused and validated for new product.

requirements.Title: Stingray Wi-Fi Module Integration
requirements.Description: Integrate Stingray Wi-Fi module for wireless connectivity.
requirements.Rationale: To provide modern wireless features and connectivity.
requirements.Dependencies: Requires hardware and firmware integration.
requirements.Acceptance Criteria: Stingray Wi-Fi module is integrated, functional, and validated in testing.

requirements.Title: FW Dune Firmware
requirements.Description: Use FW Dune as the firmware platform for the printer.
requirements.Rationale: To leverage existing firmware capabilities and reduce development time.
requirements.Dependencies: Firmware compatibility with new hardware.
requirements.Acceptance Criteria: FW Dune is used as firmware, fully functional with new hardware.

requirements.Title: Gauss4.xx Security (HW & FW)
requirements.Description: Implement Gauss4.xx security features in both hardware and firmware.
requirements.Rationale: To enhance product security and protect against threats.
requirements.Dependencies: Requires hardware and firmware updates.
requirements.Acceptance Criteria: Gauss4.xx security features are implemented and validated in product.

requirements.Title: Business Model Support for Consumer, SMB, Enterprise
requirements.Description: Support business models for Consumer, SMB, and Enterprise segments, including PaaS, WorkFromHome/Flexworker, and onboarding via multiple HP paths.
requirements.Rationale: To address diverse market needs and expand market reach.
requirements.Dependencies: Requires service and solution integration.
requirements.Acceptance Criteria: Product supports all listed business models and onboarding paths.

requirements.Title: Scan Solution and SMB/Enterprise Manageability
requirements.Description: Integrate scan solution and manageability features for SMB and Enterprise, including WJA, HPSM, and JAM support.
requirements.Rationale: To provide robust scanning and management capabilities for business customers.
requirements.Stakeholders: SMB, Enterprise, Product Management, IT Admins
requirements.Dependencies: Requires solution integration and compatibility testing.
requirements.Acceptance Criteria: Product supports scan solution and listed manageability features, validated in enterprise environments.

requirements.Title: Clients & Drivers Support (HPX, PSA, SUPD, UPD, EasyStart, USS, UFD)
requirements.Description: Support for various clients and drivers, including HPX, PSA, SUPD, UPD, EasyStart, USS, and UFD.
requirements.Rationale: To ensure broad compatibility with different user environments and platforms.
requirements.Stakeholders: End Users, IT Admins, Product Management
requirements.Dependencies: Requires driver and client integration.
requirements.Acceptance Criteria: All listed clients and drivers are supported and validated for the product.

requirements.Title: Protect Micro/SMB Segments and Profit Pool
requirements.Description: Strategically protect HP’s micro/SMB segments and safeguard the traditional ink/laser profit pool from competitors.
requirements.Rationale: To maintain HP's market leadership and profitability.
requirements.Dependencies: Requires alignment with business and marketing strategies.
requirements.Acceptance Criteria: Market share and profit pool are maintained or improved in micro/SMB segments post-launch.

requirements.Title: Lead with LaserJet, Flank with PDL in Medium/Enterprise
requirements.Description: Lead with LaserJet and flank with PDL in medium and enterprise segments to win over competitors, especially Epson, as CISS grows.
requirements.Rationale: To strengthen market position in key segments and drive growth in CISS adoption.
requirements.Dependencies: Requires product positioning and feature alignment.
requirements.Acceptance Criteria: LaserJet and PDL products are effectively positioned and adopted in target segments.

requirements.Title: Grow CISS Profitable Share in New Segments
requirements.Description: Expand CISS (Continuous Ink Supply System) profitable share by targeting new market segments.
requirements.Rationale: To drive growth and profitability in emerging markets.
requirements.Dependencies: Requires market analysis and targeted product features.
requirements.Acceptance Criteria: CISS product share and profitability increase in new segments post-launch.

requirements.Title: Highly Leverage Watt-LE Mech Platform, Marconi-Hi Product, and Solutions
requirements.Description: Maximize use of Watt-LE mechanical platform, Marconi-Hi product (Reddington ID), and related solutions for development.
requirements.Rationale: To reduce development time and investment by reusing proven platforms and solutions.
requirements.Dependencies: Compatibility with new product requirements.
requirements.Acceptance Criteria: Product is developed on Watt-LE and Marconi-Hi platform with integrated solutions.

requirements.Title: Integrate CISS IDS, NOA-F, and Ink Tanks
requirements.Description: Integrate CISS IDS, NOA-F, and new ink tanks into the product design.
requirements.Rationale: To deliver a seamless, high-capacity ink delivery solution.
requirements.Dependencies: Requires coordinated hardware and system design.
requirements.Acceptance Criteria: CISS IDS, NOA-F, and ink tanks are integrated, functional, and validated in product.

requirements.Title: New NGB Keyed Ink Bottles Integration
requirements.Description: Integrate new NGB keyed ink bottles into the product design and supply chain.
requirements.Rationale: To enhance security, compatibility, and user experience.
requirements.Dependencies: Bottle and tank design, supply chain updates.
requirements.Acceptance Criteria: NGB keyed ink bottles are integrated and validated for product use.

requirements.Title: Schedule Adherence as Highest Priority Constraint
requirements.Description: Maintain schedule as the least flexible (highest priority) constraint in the project.
requirements.Rationale: To ensure timely market launch and competitive positioning.
requirements.Dependencies: Project planning and resource allocation.
requirements.Acceptance Criteria: Project milestones are met as scheduled, with minimal delays.

requirements.Title: SuperAmp PHA Life at 65K Pages
requirements.Description: Ensure SuperAmp PHA achieves a minimum life of 65,000 pages.
requirements.Rationale: To meet reliability and cost targets for high-volume users.
requirements.Dependencies: PHA design and reliability testing.
requirements.Acceptance Criteria: SuperAmp PHA demonstrates at least 65K page life in testing.

requirements.Title: Warranty Life of 2 Years or 80K Pages
requirements.Description: Provide a warranty life of 2 years or 80,000 pages, whichever comes first.
requirements.Rationale: To offer competitive warranty coverage and ensure customer satisfaction.
requirements.Dependencies: Component durability and reliability.
requirements.Acceptance Criteria: Warranty terms are documented and validated for 2 years/80K pages.

requirements.Title: Serviceability via Maintenance Box
requirements.Description: Enable serviceability through a maintenance box for easy maintenance and part replacement.
requirements.Rationale: To simplify servicing and reduce downtime.
requirements.Dependencies: Maintenance box design and service procedures.
requirements.Acceptance Criteria: Maintenance box is included and functional for servicing.

requirements.Title: SMB Solution Support
requirements.Description: Provide solution features specifically for SMB customers, including manageability and integration.
requirements.Rationale: To address SMB market needs and improve competitiveness.
requirements.Dependencies: Solution development and integration.
requirements.Acceptance Criteria: SMB solution features are implemented and validated.

requirements.Title: Host 12K-CMYK and Trade Page 6K as Flexible Priorities
requirements.Description: Consider support for 12K-CMYK host and trade page 6K as flexible (lowest priority) requirements.
requirements.Rationale: To allow for future scalability and market differentiation.
requirements.Dependencies: Depends on market feedback and technical feasibility.
requirements.Acceptance Criteria: Features are considered and implemented if feasible and needed.
